title: شرح أخطاء المبتدئين في استخدام السيميكولون
continuity: A young adult programmer in a navy hoodie sits at a wooden desk with a warm desk lamp, surrounded by notebooks and a coffee mug, in a quiet home office setting.

shots.visual_prompt: A slow push-in on hands resting on a notebook, fingers slightly curled as the person looks down at the page
shots.opening_action: The person flips a page in their notebook and stops, eyes scanning the lines
shots.closing_action: The person taps their finger twice on the page, then looks up with a thoughtful frown

shots.visual_prompt: A steady dolly-in on the person's face as they gently rub their temple and look at a blank screen
shots.opening_action: The person leans forward and taps the desk with one finger
shots.closing_action: They pause, then slowly remove their hand and look at the notebook with a puzzled expression

shots.visual_prompt: A slow tracking shot from the side, following the person as they write notes on a notepad with a pen
shots.opening_action: The person writes a short phrase on the notepad and pauses to look at it
shots.closing_action: They smile slightly and place the notepad down, then take a sip from their coffee mug
